﻿## Bookings
- Conference rooms reserved with no guest assigned stay on the calendar as hold (including programme days)
- Monthly hold styling for those reserved empty rooms

## Value of Service
- Split conference statements by family, people, or date range, with coverage totals
- Whole families named once on the document (not every member)
- Additional day guests include unnamed meal-plan day guests as one amount

## Guest Inbox
- Compose and reply To fields search the contact list by name or email
